def is_leap_year(y):
    return (y % 4 == 0 and y % 100 != 0) or y % 400 == 0

# Test various years
test_cases = [
    (2000, True),   # Divisible by 400 - leap year
    (1900, False),  # Divisible by 100 but not 400 - NOT leap year  
    (1896, True),   # Divisible by 4, not 100 - leap year
    (2024, True),   # Divisible by 4, not 100 - leap year
    (2023, False),  # Not divisible by 4 - NOT leap year
    (2100, False),  # Divisible by 100 but not 400 - NOT leap year
    (2400, True),   # Divisible by 400 - leap year
]

    result = is_leap_year(y)
    status = "✓" if result == expected else "✗"
    print(f"{status} {y}: expected={expected}, got={result}")
